title: Kamishiro Rui — Wonderlands×Showtime〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's keeping Rui?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He said he'd be gone just a moment, but we've been waiting here for ages!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Calm down, he's only been gone for three minutes. Even dogs have more patience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you saying I'm worse than a dog?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, it's not right to call people over just to make them wait...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eek, a spooky ghost in a red cape!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think this may put you in a better mood, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let me guess. You finished upgrading Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Bingo.
Would you like to see her?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yesss! Show us, show us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to see her too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, let's see if it can impress me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like a drum roll first.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A drum roll. You know, to set the mood.
I'm about to reveal my newest creation after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ba-dum! Ba-ba-ba-boom-boom-baaah♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Are just you going to beatbox it?!
Anyway, it didn't sound like a drum roll at all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Looks like I have to show you how to do it.
Are you ready? Dum-dum-dum! Is anyone going to join in, or what?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it! Ba-ba-ba-boom♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Ba-ba-ba-dum-tsss...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then! Feast your eyes!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oooh... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It looks the same as before...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe. Don't judge the book by its cover.
Nene, come stand in front of Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hail thee, Miss Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She... She can speak?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Miss Nene, I bring you an offering of grapefruit juice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She produced a can of grapefruit juice from a hidden compartment inside her arm? It's even chilled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've installed an AI and a facial recognition system. Besides us, she can also remember audience members.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In addition to that, I equipped her with a few new features which should be a great hit with children.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What features are those?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's have a demonstration.
Tsukasa, could you stand over there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is here okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's perfect.
Wait there while we back off a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hold on, why are you backing off?!
Is this going to be dangerous? Am I at risk here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, fire!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Initiating Rocket Punch... Fire!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aaargh! Huh...?
It stopped an inch from my face?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As you can see, there's a built-in safety feature preventing the rocket from hitting anything, but you should never aim it at people, just as an extra precaution.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, do I not count as people?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This was an example illustrating what you should not do under any circumstances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for your cooperation, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're welco—no!
Don't mess with me, Rui. I didn't know what I was signing up for!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, there's more to Robo-Nene's new move.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't pretend you didn't hear me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you're going to be blown away by this nifty little trick, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wooow!
Robo-Nene's fist exploded!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A hidden party popper? It spooked the pigeons!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That was actually fun!
Kids are going to love it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe, he forgot all about being upset.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nene, penny for your thoughts.
Do you like your robot's upgrades?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Miss Nene, how do you evaluate me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can you change it so that she calls me just Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, sure. I take it that all the other features have earned your approval.
